owned_invariants: Tests run the real pfp_operad binary; none replaces the host's verdict with a Python one.

boundaries: Offline fixtures only; fixtures are not live model trials.

score.level_basis: L2 verification support: explicit fixtures and finite negative controls with source-bound outcomes.

basis.G1: Each test name states the claim it checks.
basis.G2: Expected verdicts and error codes follow from the reply written in the test.
basis.G3: Each way the host can fail to answer is asserted by its error code.
basis.G4: All 9 pass in the recorded run; with the WF2 tests they killed 20 of 22 transport mutants and 28 of 35 WF2 workflow mutants.
basis.G5: Measured worst cyclomatic 2, cognitive 1, nesting 1; ceiling A+, recorded A.

evidence.note: 633 offline tests (pfp/workflows, pfp_core/workflow_families, exclusions) against the release build of pfp_operad 0.2.0; exact source inputs bound. No live model performance claim.
